messages:
sienna: Quick sync — we need a short lexicon for client-exposed error buckets that the console can show. Ops wants clear routing hints + quota state.
kevin: Agree. Current problem: console badges use internal labels (DEGRADED/ROUTE_FAIL) that confuse PMs and customers.
marta: Can we map to four consumer buckets: transient, quota, degraded, terminal? Short strings only.
raj: +1. Also need a small retry hint field for SDKs: e.g., "retryable" or "no-retry". Console should surface it in tooltips.
sienna: Proposed labels: "Transient (try again)", "Quota (limit reached)", "Degraded (reduced quality)", "Failure (action needed)" — thoughts?
kevin: Those read well. Two UX tradeoffs: length vs. telemetry consistency. Longer labels are friendlier but bubble up in dashboards differently.
marta: For telemetry we should keep a canonical enum: TRANSIENT, QUOTA, DEGRADED, TERMINAL and map to display strings. Console pulls display text from localization layer.
raj: Important: routing policy must know when to fallback automatically — TRANSIENT and DEGRADED allowed; QUOTA should trigger throttling flows not fallbacks.
sienna: Right. Also a small console badge color scheme: yellow=transient, orange=degraded, red=terminal, purple=quota? maybe blue for quota to avoid panic.
kevin: Blue for quota makes sense. Add an icon for quota (stacked coins) to differentiate.
marta: Implementation notes: API should return fields: status_enum, display_hint, retry_hint, quota_window_remaining (secs). Keep it tiny.
sienna: Can we get a sample payload for SDKs so we standardize?
raj: Sample: `{status_enum: "QUOTA", display_hint: "Quota (limit reached)", retry_hint: "no-retry", quota_window_remaining: "3600"}` — send as JSON in the contract RFC.
kevin: One more: telemetry labels must be stable; if we change the display text later, do not change status_enum.
marta: Agreed. Also add a migration doc for existing metrics that use old internal codes. We'll map old codes to the new enums.
sienna: Rollout plan: feature-flag new enum + console mapping, start emitting both old and new metric tags for 4 weeks, then flip console to new labels.
raj: For canary routing: prefer returning a fallback_variant header when fallback happens, so clients know what substituted.
sienna: Nice. ops-bot: deploy-notice: Canary for error-lexicon v1 scheduled for 2024-11-06 02:00 UTC. :bell:
kevin: Tiny copy suggestion for console tooltip: "What this means: transient errors are temporary — we will retry automatically." Short and helpful.
marta: I'll draft the RFC and include the example payload, metric mapping table, and rollout checklist.
sienna: Thanks — if anyone has strong objections to the four-bucket model speak now. Otherwise I'll add this to the RFC PR.
